description: WaterGAP 2 is a global hydrology and water-use model family developed at Goethe University Frankfurt. This repository publishes its C++ source, including water-balance, routing and parameter routines, and the GMD article describes version 2.2e. Spatial coverage is global in the model description; the repository is source code, not a fixed time-series product. Public code and the linked version archive are free under LGPL-3.0. Modellers can inspect and adapt the published routines when building water-resource or climate-impact simulations. A major limitation is explicit in the current README: the code is not compilable and the model is not executable. The maintainers have not supplied the full input data, water-use models, documentation or support needed for others to run it. This draft therefore records reference source for reuse, not a ready-to-run simulator or a reproduction of the article. The separately published WaterGAP streamflow calibration dataset has its own identity and licence. No compilation or execution was attempted.
